steps.eval: (async () => { window.__waitUntil = async (fn, pred, timeout = 4500) => { const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < timeout) { let v; let ok = false; try { v = fn(); ok = pred(v); } catch { ok = false; } if (ok) return v; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 30)); } return fn(); }; window.__eventosState = () => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-mode]'); const panel = document.querySelector('[data-open-panel="eventos"]'); const scroller = panel.querySelector('[data-stage-scroller]'); const inv = Number(panel.querySelector('[data-eventos-invitados]').textContent); const menosDis = panel.querySelector('[data-eventos-menos]').disabled; const masDis = panel.querySelector('[data-eventos-mas]').disabled; const oca = panel.querySelector('[data-eventos-ocasion][aria-checked="true"]')?.dataset.eventosOcasion; const fmt = panel.querySelector('[data-eventos-formato][aria-checked="true"]')?.dataset.eventosFormato; const cards = {}; ['kg', 'botellas', 'mozos', 'pasos', 'horas', 'presupuesto'].forEach((id) => { const vEl = panel.querySelector(`[data-eventos-valor="${id}"] p`); const eWrap = panel.querySelector(`[data-eventos-etiqueta="${id}"] p`); const eOut = eWrap.children[0]; const eIn = eWrap.children[1]; cards[id] = { valor: vEl.textContent.replace(/\u00a0/g, ' '), etiqueta: eIn.textContent, settled: getComputedStyle(eOut).display === 'none' && !eIn.style.clipPath }; }); return { stage: [root.dataset.mode, root.dataset.active, root.dataset.texts, location.hash], fits100svh: scroller.scrollHeight <= scroller.clientHeight, invitados: inv, menosDis, masDis, ocasion: oca, formato: fmt, valores: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(cards).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.valor])), etiquetas: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(cards).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.etiqueta])), allSettled: Object.values(cards).every((c) => c.settled) }; }; return await __waitUntil(__eventosState, (s) => s.stage[0] === 'open' && s.stage[2] === '3' && s.valores.presupuesto === '$ 22.000' && s.valores.botellas === '16' && s.allSettled); })()
